citingPaper.title: Nanodiamonds in Biomedical Advances: From Bioactive Materials to Quantum Sensors

contexts: In life sciences, subtle temperature variations accompany intracellular metabolism, gene expression and protein interactions, and real-time monitoring of such changes is essential for understanding life processes 2 .
In addition, diamond features excellent chemical stability and biocompatibility, allowing long-term and stable measurements in complex environments ranging from extreme conditions to living cells 2 .
